def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cups=find_cups(g)
    for comp in cups:
        ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        top,bot,l,r=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        gap=[j for j in range(l,r+1) if g[top][j]==0][0]
        g[top][gap]=2
        for i in range(top+1,bot):
            for j in range(l+1,r):
                if g[i][j]==0: g[i][j]=2
        nleft=sum(1 for j in range(l,gap) if g[top][j]==5)
        nright=sum(1 for j in range(gap+1,r+1) if g[top][j]==5)
        rng=range(0,gap+1) if nleft>=nright else range(gap,W)
        for j in rng: g[top-1][j]=2
    return g

lib='''
def components(grid, color):
    """The connected components (4-neighborhood) of cells of the given color, as lists of (row, col)."""
    H, W, seen, out = len(grid), len(grid[0]), set(), []
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if grid[i][j] == color and (i, j) not in seen:
                st, comp = [(i, j)], []
                seen.add((i, j))
                while st:
                    y, x = st.pop(); comp.append((y, x))
                    for ny, nx in ((y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)):
                        if 0 <= ny < H and 0 <= nx < W and grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny, nx)); st.append((ny, nx))
                out.append(comp)
    return out

def bbox(cells):
    """The (top, bottom, left, right) bounding box of a list of (row, col) cells."""
    ys = [p[0] for p in cells]; xs = [p[1] for p in cells]
    return min(ys), max(ys), min(xs), max(xs)

def fill_inside(grid, top, bottom, left, right, color, skip=()):
    """Recolor every 0 strictly inside the given rectangle to color, except cells in skip."""
    for i in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for j in range(left + 1, right):
            if grid[i][j] == 0 and (i, j) not in skip:
                grid[i][j] = color
    return grid

def ray_to_edge(grid, row, col, direction, color):
    """Draw color from (row, col) to the grid edge in direction 'left' or 'right' (inclusive of the start cell)."""
    W = len(grid[0])
    rng = range(0, col + 1) if direction == 'left' else range(col, W)
    for j in rng:
        grid[row][j] = color
    return grid
'''

        gap = [j for j in range(l, r + 1) if g[top][j] == 0][0]
        g[top][gap] = 2
        fill_inside(g, top, bot, l, r, 2)
        nleft = sum(1 for j in range(l, gap) if g[top][j] == 5)
        nright = sum(1 for j in range(gap + 1, r + 1) if g[top][j] == 5)
        ray_to_edge(g, top - 1, gap, 'left' if nleft >= nright else 'right', 2)
    return g
'''
